title: Avalon Landing RV Park

services.name: On-Site Salt Water Fishing
services.desc: Avalon Landing RV Park Pensacola maintains a Florida site-specific pier saltwater fishing license that enables all of Avalon’s guests to fish off of our dock and bridge without having to apply and pay for a Florida resident or non-resident saltwater fishing license. gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: This is my second stay here, and I found it as delightful as my first. The campground is laid out in two pieces straddling a largish channel off the Indian Bayou. Kayaking must be awesome, but I did not have the time. A family emergency caused me to trim my stay to one night. Fair warning, there are no exceptions to the cancellation policy, so don't even try.
